role: Filters the Polar SDK's log stream into the app debug log and narrates disconnects; split off PolarManager for type-size reasons.
types: PolarSDKLogBridge: enum — SDK log filter + disconnect narration
state: mem:PolarSDKLogBridge.suppressed (private static let, 5 substrings: 'PMD Data','Factor not stored',' HEX ','peripheral with session discovered','Scanning next')

units.does: Drops SDK log lines containing any suppressed substring; logs every other line to the debug log prefixed '[PolarSDK]'.

branches.cond: line contains none of the suppressed substrings
branches.effect: true → debugLog it; false → return silently

units.does: Logs a disconnect: a plain line when not streaming; during a session a line saying identity is kept while reconnecting, plus a warning when the drop was a pairing error.

branches.effect: false → log 'Device disconnected (not streaming)' and return; true → session narration
true → extra warning-level 'Pairing failure reported on disconnect'; false → nothing more

units.does: Logs an SDK feature the app does not map, via debugLogExternal with cause .strap.
